Instrument (EN): Basic Psychological Need Satisfaction and Frustration Scale
Scales / measured domains (EN): Autonomy Satisfaction (4); Autonomy Frustration (4); Competence Satisfaction (4); Competence Frustration (4); Relatedness Satisfaction (4); Relatedness Frustration (4)
EN form: EN original cross-cultural 24-item equivalence USA sample
Other translations: NL Belgium; ZH China original cross-cultural study; PT Portugal 2018 validation
Target population: Late adolescents / students and adults (original four-country validation)
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Copyright CSDT questionnaire: NONcommercial academic use only; obtain written permission for any commercial platform/digital delivery
Verification notes / safety gate: Measure frustration separately from low satisfaction; six 4-item domains, not one clinical diagnosis.

Scales / measured domains (EN): Guilt-Negative Behavior Evaluation (4); Guilt-Repair (4); Shame-Negative Self Evaluation (4); Shame-Withdraw (4)

RU form: RU exact version validation not verified
